title: Review adapter UX and required packs v1

output.summary: Approve adapter UX polish and required review pack policy.

approvedRows.question: Should CodeWiki surface skipped/not-run review pack reasons and support required packs?
approvedRows.currentState: Review evidence summarizes reports, but skipped packs are not explicit, not-run messages are generic, and teams cannot mark packs as required evidence gates.
approvedRows.desiredState: Review pack execution records selected/skipped pack outcomes, adapter not-run summaries explain missing tools/scripts/matching files, and quality.review.requiredPacks turns missing/failed required pack evidence into blocking CodeWiki diagnostics.
approvedRows.rationale: Users need actionable feedback when evidence is absent, and teams need strict evidence policy without treating external tools as semantic authority.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users can see why packs did not run and opt into fail-closed pack requirements.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers must preserve required-pack validation, bounded summaries, and adapter-specific no-run reasons.
approvedRows.routeRationale: Needs config schema, pack metadata, adapter messages, required policy wiring, docs, and tests.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: This is the next hardening layer after review evidence UX.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: User agreed to adapter UX polish followed by requiredPacks policy.
agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Improves false-pass resistance and review explainability.
agentAssessment.rationale: External tools remain evidence sensors; CodeWiki emits the policy diagnostic.

approvedRows.currentPain: Generic not-run evidence and silent skipped packs make absent evidence hard to diagnose; missing required evidence cannot fail closed.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: Skipped/not-run pack reasons are exposed and required packs block when relevant evidence does not run/pass.
approvedRows.successSignal: Tests prove skipped/not-run summaries, config validation, required-pack blocking, docs, and full validation.
nonGoals: Do not make external tools semantic authority.
Do not require packs for languages with no changed files.
